title: 第2179章 灭杀悟道第2178章 战大罗宗修士
content_zh:
，，！
灭杀，悟道大罗天阵在天苍星域鼎鼎大名，大罗宗修士凝结此阵，改变天地环境，形成一种对自己极为有利的场域。
在很多顶级大势力修士眼中，此阵比绝品神通还要厉害，已经接近于半步超绝品神通了。
不少与大罗宗作对的强者，死在大罗天阵中。
“在大罗天阵中，老夫便代表着天，给老夫束缚。”
大罗宗合体境后期强者一脸傲然，抬手虚空一指，便见一股恐怖的力量，悄无声息在林浩四周显现，形成一个牢笼。
林浩面对在大罗天阵加持后，堪比合体境巅峰强者出手，凝聚的能量牢笼，他嘴角露出一抹冷笑。
“掌中世界神通。”
林浩右手一挥，掌心中凝聚的天外世界场景，呼啸而出。
“代表着天，你配吗？”
林浩讥讽道。
“怎么可能！”
大罗宗合体境后期强者脸色一变，他发现大罗天阵形成的特殊天地环境，竟然在迅速消退。
并且，仅眨眼时间不到，大罗天阵的环境，就被一种极其诡异，不属于天苍星域的环境所取代。
“啊！
这……这是天外世界的力量！
你怎么可能！”
大罗宗合体境后期强者瞳孔一缩，露出惊骇之色。
能量牢笼在崩散，林浩操控的天外世界场景，将一群大罗宗修士笼罩。
顿时可怖的天外世界力量，化作神秘火焰，焚烧大罗宗修士的神魂、肉身、识海，并且还伴随着可怕的头脑昏沉之感。

林浩在魔龙山秘境，藉助界海之水狂暴力量，耗费一百多年冲破瓶颈，从半步合体境极致达到合体境，不光是适应了狂暴力量，还将狂暴力量融入了肉身、神魂、识海。
要知道界海狂暴力量，才是真正的天外世界力量。
林浩如今突破到合体境，以界海狂暴力量，来施展掌中世界神通，蕴含的威力，可比在炼虚境施展此神通，强了不知道多少倍。
大罗宗修士中实力最强的合体境后期修士，面露惊恐之色，道：“超绝品神通，你到底是谁？”
他内心不安，果断施展出一种大罗宗秘法遁术，企图想要逃离。
林浩却是从原地消失，鲲鹏秘法在天外世界场景中施展，可以得到加持，快得已经达到极速。
嗡！
虚空轻轻震动，林浩的身形，在遁走的大罗宗合体境后期修士前方显现。
他体内五行至尊元神拥有的浩瀚元力，在瞒天珠遮掩下，伪装成伪五行灵根所具备的元力气息，加上半步化血境的肉身力量，呼啸而出。
林浩以顶级近战神通灵巫百战之法，向大罗宗合体境后期修士出手。
此人脸色阴沉，手中出现一把巨锤，闪耀出奇异符文，向林浩砸去。
砰！
巨响声回荡，大罗宗合体境后期修士只感觉一股巨力袭来，他握着巨锤的手虎口开裂，瞬间便鲜血淋漓。
只是一交手，他竟然握不住巨锤，整条胳膊在林浩的力量下，都发生了骨折，出现咔嚓咔嚓的声音。
当！
林浩大开大合的拳掌齐出，施展灵巫百战近身交手神通，一连串攻击狠狠的落下。
大罗宗合体境后期强者，明明觉得自己修为境界超过林浩很多，却有种无力之感，在被碾压。
砰！
噗……！
仅数息时间不到，这名大罗宗合体境后期强者便口吐鲜血不断，各种底牌施展出来，也是无用，最后被林浩硬生生的打爆。

这恐怖的一幕，让其余大罗宗修士难以置信，他们心中恐惧的同时，又无比愤怒。
“我大罗宗替大罗仙域执掌灵界，你胆敢杀大罗宗的人，不止是你一人要死，你的血亲、朋友、族人，但凡与你有关的人，都将遭到血洗。”
平日里大罗宗修士高高在上，横行霸道惯了。
哪怕林浩表现得非常逆天，可以碾压他们，大罗宗修士依旧一副居高临下的样子，其中一人阴狠的道：“我大罗宗有特殊密器，能查因果，能够将与你有关系的人，全部查出来，你这罪人快些束手就擒，我们还能在杀你的血亲等人之时，放了他们的魂魄，让他们有重新投胎的机会。”
content_en:
,,!
The Daluo Heavenly Formation of Killing and Enlightenment is famous in the Tiancang Star Region. The Daluo Sect monks condense this formation to change the environment of heaven and earth, forming a field that is extremely beneficial to themselves.
In the eyes of many top powerful cultivators, this formation is even more powerful than a top-notch magical power, and is already close to a half-step super-premium magic power.
Many strong men who opposed Da Luo Sect died in Da Luo Tian Formation.
"In the Da Luo Tian Formation, I represent the sky and bind me."
The strong man in the late stage of Da Luo Zong's Fusion Realm looked proud, raised his hand and pointed in the air, and saw a terrifying force appearing silently around Lin Hao, forming a cage.
Lin Hao had a sneer on his face when faced with the energy cage that had been gathered by the Da Luo Tian Formation, which was comparable to the action of a peak Fusion Realm powerhouse.
"The magical power of the world in the palm of your hand."
Lin Hao waved his right hand, and the scene from the outer world condensed in his palm roared out.
"Representing heaven, are you worthy?"
Lin Hao sneered.
"How is that possible!"
The expression of the strong man in the late stage of Daluo Sect Fusion Realm changed. He discovered that the special heaven and earth environment formed by Daluo Tianzhen was fading rapidly.
Moreover, in less than a blink of an eye, the environment of the Daluo Tianzhen was replaced by an extremely strange environment that did not belong to the Tiancang Star Territory.
"Ah!
This...this is the power of the outer world!
How could you! "
The strong man in the late stage of Da Luo Zong's Fusion Realm shrank his pupils, showing a look of horror.
The energy cage was disintegrating, and the scene in the outer world controlled by Lin Hao enveloped a group of Daluo Sect monks.
Suddenly, the terrifying power of the outer world turned into a mysterious flame, burning the soul, body, and sea of ​​consciousness of the Daluo Sect monks, and was accompanied by a terrible feeling of dizziness.
Lin Hao spent more than a hundred years in the secret realm of Demon Dragon Mountain, relying on the violent power of the water of the Boundary Sea, to break through the bottleneck and reach the ultimate integration state from the half-step integration state. Not only did he adapt to the violent force, but he also integrated the violent force into his body, soul, and sea of ​​consciousness.
You must know that the violent power of the world sea is the real power of the outer world.
Lin Hao has now broken through to the Fusion Realm, and uses the violent power of the world sea to display the magical power of the world in his palm. The power contained in it is countless times stronger than the magical power used in the Void Refining Realm.
The most powerful late-stage Fusion Realm monk among the Daluo Sect monks showed a look of horror on his face and said: "Superior level magical power, who are you?"
He felt uneasy and decisively used a Daluo Sect secret escape technique in an attempt to escape.
However, Lin Hao disappeared from the place. Kunpeng's secret method was used in the outer world scene and could be blessed, so fast that it reached the top speed.
Buzz!
The void shook slightly, and Lin Hao's figure appeared in front of the escaped Daluo Sect late stage monk.
The vast Yuan Power possessed by the Five Elements Supreme Yuan Shen in his body, covered by the Hidden Heaven Bead, disguised as the Yuan Power breath possessed by the pseudo Five Elements Spiritual Roots, coupled with the physical power of the Half-Step Blood Transformation Realm, roared out.
Lin Hao used the method of the top melee psychic witch to attack the monks in the late stage of Daluo Sect's Fusion Realm.
The man's face was gloomy, and a giant hammer appeared in his hand, shining with strange runes, and struck Lin Hao.
Bang!
The loud noise echoed, and the monk in the late stage of Da Luo Zong's Fusion Realm only felt a huge force coming. The hand holding the giant hammer cracked open, and blood dripped instantly.
After just one fight, he couldn't hold the giant hammer. Under Lin Hao's strength, his whole arm was fractured and there was a clicking sound.
when!
Lin Hao opened and closed his fists and palms in unison, using the spirit witch's close combat magical power, and landed a series of attacks fiercely.
A strong person in the late stage of Daluo Sect's Fusion Realm clearly feels that his level of cultivation is much higher than that of Lin Hao, but he still feels powerless and is being crushed.
Bang!
puff……!
In less than a few breaths, this strong man in the late stage of Da Luo Zong's Fusion Realm was vomiting blood constantly. He used all kinds of trump cards, but it was useless. In the end, he was beaten by Lin Hao.
This terrifying scene made other Da Luo ZongxiuThe soldiers couldn't believe it. They were frightened and at the same time extremely angry.
"We, Daluo Sect, are in charge of the spiritual world for Daluo Immortal Realm. If you dare to kill people from Daluo Sect, you will not only die, but your blood relatives, friends, tribesmen, and everyone related to you will be bloodbathed."
On weekdays, Daluo Sect monks are aloof and domineering.
Even though Lin Hao behaved very defiantly and could crush them, the Daluo Sect monks still looked condescending. One of them said viciously: "I, the Daluo Sect, have a special secret weapon that can check cause and effect, and can find out all the people who are related to you. You, the sinner, will be captured as soon as possible. When we kill your blood relatives and others, we can also release their souls and give them a chance to reincarnate."
